works.body:
Nice to meet you, I am a Vtuber.
My name is Nao Koumine, and I am a Vtuber.
I sent you a Skeb request because I thought your style was really cute...! I am a Vtuber and I'm a Vtuber!
My character is a "blonde-haired, blue-eyed, male-daughter sister",
I would like you to draw me a picture of her wearing a T-shirt in a loose and cute style.

Her expression should be soft and smiling,
The composition of the picture is up to the artist, with no particular specifications.
We would like to use the drawing for Twitter, Youtube, and monetized TwitWeb,
We will use it as a thumbnail for Twitter, Youtube, and monetized Twitch.
We would like to see transparent images of people,
We would also appreciate it if the head and face area is not obscured.
https://x.com/Yukimine_sister

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1C3pGPzAVCq8ocARQQ0Mjl_UZsLXsRVZ8

Dear Ebatan
Thank you very much for your kind attention.
I would like to take advantage of your commission-free campaign and make a thick request for you to draw my guess again!

This time, I would like to request an illustration to celebrate the 7th anniversary of Shido Rio's delivery.

Please leave it to me to choose either "idol costume" or "maid costume" as the costume!
Happy 7th anniversary! We would be very happy if you could draw it in a bright and happy atmosphere, full of the congratulatory mood of "Congratulations on your 7th anniversary!

We would be very happy if you could draw it in a bright and happy atmosphere with a celebratory mood.
Thank you in advance for your consideration.

As a side note, the bunny girl illustration you drew last time
I have made a tapestry of it and displayed it on my "Pidana🦁"!
I look at it every day and am cheered up by the cheerful atmosphere. I am truly grateful.

Dear Ebatan, nice to meet you.
I am pleased to see that you are looking for a skeb and would like to make a request.

I would like to request you to create a fan art of Rio Shido.

Character] Rio Shido (Personal Vtuber)

Purpose of use】Fan art, smartphone/PC wallpaper, SNS icon, header

Theme] We would like you to create one of the following themes that Ebatan-sama says, "You may draw! I would like you to create one of the following themes.

1. Smiling face in bunny girl outfit.
Wear a bunny ear catsuit between your lion ears!
*We wanted to have a drawing of the Super Bingo people celebrating their Super Bingo people from the bingo tournament that was delivered.

2. A figure happily waving a penlight in a live T-shirt.
T-shirt reference: https://stellamagna-goods.stores.jp/
We wanted to depict Stella Magna's live concert scheduled in February, and we wanted to depict them enjoying the live concert.

3. A figure dressed as a maid making sweets.
We would like to see a scene where she is boiling chocolate and tasting it!
We wanted to draw a scene that reminds us of Valentine's Day chocolates in February.


I got to know Ebatan-sama from Shido Rio's fan art.
Illustration in idol costume! It was soooooo cute!
I would like to send a request to Ebatan-sama to draw more guesses.

If the content of the request is against your will, please cancel the request.

Nice to meet you.
If you don't mind, I'd like to make an icon for Twitter with my child.

My child (https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/90204114)

Any pose is fine, but please make it bright and cute with a little movement.

I hope you will accept. Thank you very much!
